title: Object-Oriented Programming
description: Classes, inheritance, polymorphism, and design patterns in Python.
instructions: Demonstrate understanding of OOP principles and Python class implementation.

questions.title: Class Design and Inheritance
questions.description:
Create a Vehicle base class and a Car subclass. Vehicle should have make, model, year. Car should add fuel_capacity. Both should have a string representation.

Requirements:
- Vehicle.__init__(make, model, year)
- Car.__init__(make, model, year, fuel_capacity)
- __str__ method for both classes

test_cases.explanation: Basic class creation and string representation

questions.hints: Use super() to call parent class methods. Format strings appropriately.

questions.title: OOP Principles
questions.description: Which of the following best describes polymorphism in Python?

options.text: The ability of different objects to respond to the same interface
Creating new classes based on existing ones

questions.explanation: Polymorphism allows objects of different types to be treated uniformly through a common interface.
